note: Deterministic state-aware scripted guardian benchmark, NOT human completion rates or full exploration campaign results. Normal simulation damage/cooldowns/collision and mechanism requirements remain intact. The pilot moves through joystick inputs and uses ordinary spells, dodge and ultimate; it never changes HP, enemy HP or exposure during a fight.

setup.stageTravel: position at each altar only before entering; use actual World interaction
setup.progression: carry earned build, damage, charge rules and camp power reward between victories

limitations: Starts at the first altar with a specified plausible five-upgrade loadout; does not measure exploration loot distribution or navigation.
Reads complete live hazard geometry; predicts projectiles and responds faster and more consistently than most people.
Random upgrade offers are selected by a fixed heuristic. No retries or healing resets within a stage.
A timeout or loss is preserved as a failure; no simulation outcome is patched.
controlsNote: Same initial build and actual combat, but the control approaches the boss and casts ultimate whenever ready. It does not read telegraphs or seek the required recovery/tide mechanisms.

metricNotes.damageTaken: Actual HP lost after shields, counted over the entire fight; excludes absorbed shield damage.
metricNotes.mechanismFailures: Cumulative failed ritual attempts across all guardian rounds, including cancelled warnings.
